scope: Chronological producer outputs TaskSection.ID.title localized date buckets. Shared V2 header and compact rows only.

findings.claim: Date buckets have ID.title raw0, which maps to header kind0. This is proved from the ID classifier and consumer, independently of the Pinned title special case.

Ordinary date headers are collapsible through the same per-section callback. The callback is installed unconditionally in the active V2 header constructor; date identity scopes it to that title bucket.
locations: 0x39cf78..0x39cf84 reads collapsed value for descriptor ID

findings.claim: Date kind0 has a visible disclosure chevron because callback exists and kind !=1. It rotates according to expansion but does not use fade-when-expanded. Only kind2 sets that flag.
Shared V2 kind0 title is body semibold with ChatGPT/text/primary. Chevron is caption regular, small image scale, ChatGPT/icon/tertiary, leading padding -2.
findings.limitation: Official custom font wrapper conversion is statically identified; native SwiftUI semantic font adapter is independent implementation.

findings.claim: Header outer HStack center spacing8, title/subtitle HStack firstTextBaseline spacing8, then chevron then Spacer(minLength:0). Entire header uses horizontal20 and shared scaled minHeight44 then vertical2.
For current ID.title, header extra topSpacing is always0. The consumer does inspect the preceding descriptor for other section types, but the current raw0 case returns0 before adjacency logic.
locations: 0x39d024..0x39d088 prepares previous descriptor and passes current descriptor as x20

findings.claim: Date task rows are not inProject. ID.raw0 maps kind0, so the project extraction fails. Compact rows omit the hidden folder placeholder and project spacing. The additional last-row bottom12 also stays0 because it requires successful project-kind extraction.
locations: 0x39b3b0..0x39b3cc only successful project extraction tests last row and writes12

findings.claim: Nonempty trimmed search preserves supplied date headers and descriptor order. Header suppression returnsfalse and effectivecollapsed becomesfalse; rows bypass saved collapse. Callback remains installed and can change saved collapse state for later empty search. This proves consumer behavior for supplied date descriptors, not which descriptors search producer emits.
findings.limitation: Search-result bucket production and backend return set are outside this consumer-only audit.

minimum_integration.search: retain supplied headers; effective expansion true; preserve saved collapsed state and toggle callback

validation.static: direct arm64 branch/register dataflow with reused SHA-bound reports

limits: No official app runtime or device geometry validation.
Date localization and chronological section ordering reuse parent v507 producer investigation.
No claim that legacy/sidebar renderers use these V2 metrics.
Whole-list custom section placement, search upstream grouping and list-composer consumers remain separate investigations.
